securityAcceptance: Source/build-surface review for #1671 adds forced Ogg, WebM/Matroska, MP3, WAV and AAC voice input alongside MOV/M4A, with Opus/Vorbis decoding and PCM/WAV output. Network protocols remain disabled; only file/pipe are enabled. Audio is bounded to one stream, 20 MiB and 180 decoded seconds, normalized to metadata-stripped AAC/M4A in the existing optional media role. Source hardening regressions remain mandatory in every restricted build. Existing HEVC/HDR, OpenH264 and zimg controls remain in force.

CVE-2025-52290.review: Upstream range remains undetermined. The published reporter describes an AAC allocation misinterpreted by the H.264 helper after a failed codec switch. The pinned helper only guarded null private data/SPS; guard-h264-context.patch now checks the actual allocated decoder and requested codec before reading private state. The build executes test-h264-context.c with an AAC decoder, H.264 codec ID and inaccessible private pointer, plus null and uninitialized H.264 cases. MPEG-TS remains absent. Inputs are forced to an explicitly allowed demuxer; audio allows only a single reviewed audio stream. The shared binary retains the H.264 context guard and its regression test. This is a reviewed local defense for the shipped surface, not a claim that upstream marks the CVE resolved.

CVE-2026-107675.review: The affected libssh/SFTP host-key path is absent: libssh and all network protocols remain disabled. Audio adds only local file/pipe input through explicitly forced demuxers.

CVE-2026-107676.review: HEVC decoding makes this applicable. initialize-hdr-payload.patch initializes every serialized HDR10+ byte and writes color-saturation flags outside the optional tone-mapping branch, matching the parser and size calculation. Every build executes test-hdr-payload.c with one/three windows, no tone mapping, saturation flags, oppositely poisoned caller buffers, round-trip parsing and guard bytes. Only selected media are normalized; frame side data and H.264 SEI are removed and output is revalidated. Matroska is now enabled for WebM voice input, so absence of that demuxer is no longer a defense. The same source hardening and poisoned-buffer regression apply to the shared binary. Audio permits one audio stream and outputs PCM/AAC without HDR side data; AV1 decoding remains absent. This is a reviewed local defense, not an upstream closure claim.

CVE-2026-107677.review: The affected DASH demuxer and SegmentTemplate path are not compiled. Enabling Ogg, Matroska, MP3, WAV and AAC does not enable DASH or HTTP/network protocols.

CVE-2026-107678.review: Applicable to upstream MOV. Local reject-encrypted-mov.patch fails pssh before any encryption-info allocation or linked-list traversal. Real codec rejection test required. CVE-2026-125224.review: Applicable: vorbis_parser.o is part of the unconditional libavcodec core object list and the Vorbis parser is enabled for Ogg and Matroska voice input, so crafted Vorbis extradata can force repeated parsing. The impact is CPU consumption inside the ffmpeg child process, which is bounded: audio input is limited to 20 MiB and 180 decoded seconds (limits.py), and every ffmpeg/ffprobe child runs through the shared runner in attachments/videos.py with RLIMIT_CPU and a wall-clock timeout of 600 seconds, a 768 MiB address-space limit and a 512 KiB probe output cap. A timeout is reported as VIDEO_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT or AUDIO_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT. This is a reviewed bounded-resource defense, not an upstream closure claim.

CVE-2026-125225.review: Applicable: the aac_adtstoasc bitstream filter is enabled for the AAC/M4A remux path. The crash needs one packet larger than 256 MiB, so that its bit count overflows 31 bits. Uploads are rejected before processing above AUDIO_MAX_SIZE (20 MiB) and VIDEO_MAX_SIZE (250 MiB) (limits.py, checked in attachments/audios.py and attachments/videos.py), so no single packet can reach 256 MiB. A crash would also stay inside the resource-limited ffmpeg child process. This is a reviewed size-bound defense, not an upstream closure claim.

CVE-2026-125250.review: The affected GIF encoder (gif_image_write_image() in libavcodec/gif.c) is not compiled. The restricted build starts with --disable-everything and its explicit encoder list (libopenh264, aac, mjpeg, wrapped_avframe and pcm_s16le) does not include it, and libavcodec/Makefile builds gif.o only with CONFIG_GIF_ENCODER.

CVE-2026-125251.review: The affected VVC decoder (alloc_frame() in libavcodec/vvc/refs.c) is not compiled. The restricted build starts with --disable-everything and its explicit decoder list (h264, hevc, opus, vorbis, aac, mp3float and PCM) does not include it, and libavcodec/vvc/Makefile builds vvc/refs.o only with CONFIG_VVC_DECODER. The advisory also requires a 32-bit build; the media binary is built on x86_64 Linux only.

CVE-2026-125252.review: The affected VAAPI decode glue (libavcodec/vaapi_decode.c) is not compiled: libavcodec/Makefile builds vaapi_decode.o only with CONFIG_VAAPI, which requires the external libva. build-ffmpeg.sh enables no hwaccel after --disable-everything and sets --disable-autodetect, so HEVC and H.264 are decoded by the software decoders only.

CVE-2026-125253.review: The affected VP9 coded bitstream backend (cbs_vp9_split_fragment() in libavcodec/cbs_vp9.c) is not compiled: libavcodec/Makefile builds cbs_vp9.o only with CONFIG_CBS_VP9, and configure selects it only for the vp9 decoder and the vp9_metadata bitstream filter, neither of which is enabled. The enabled filter_units bitstream filter therefore has no VP9 support. The advisory also requires a 32-bit build; the media binary is built on x86_64 Linux only.

CVE-2026-125254.review: The affected VVC decoder (ff_vvc_slice_rpl() and ff_vvc_mv_scale() in libavcodec/vvc/) is not compiled. The restricted build starts with --disable-everything and its explicit decoder list (h264, hevc, opus, vorbis, aac, mp3float and PCM) does not include it, and libavcodec/vvc/Makefile builds the VVC objects only with CONFIG_VVC_DECODER.

CVE-2026-125255.review: The affected MJPEG decoder (ff_mjpeg_decode_sof() in libavcodec/mjpegdec.c) is not compiled. The restricted build starts with --disable-everything and its explicit decoder list (h264, hevc, opus, vorbis, aac, mp3float and PCM) does not include it, libavcodec/Makefile builds mjpegdec.o only with CONFIG_MJPEG_DECODER, and the enabled mjpeg encoder does not select the decoder. The advisory also requires an NVDEC or similar hwaccel, and build-ffmpeg.sh enables no hwaccel after --disable-everything and sets --disable-autodetect.

CVE-2026-125256.review: The affected RISC-V vector routine (ff_llvidenc_diff_bytes_rvv() in libavcodec/riscv/llvidencdsp_rvv.S) is not compiled: libavcodec/riscv/Makefile builds it only for RISC-V targets with CONFIG_LLVIDENCDSP, the media binary is built on x86_64 Linux only, and configure selects llvidencdsp only for the huffyuv, utvideo, magicyuv, png and apng encoders. The restricted build starts with --disable-everything and its explicit encoder list (libopenh264, aac, mjpeg, wrapped_avframe and pcm_s16le) does not include any of them.

CVE-2026-125257.review: The affected Nellymoser encoder (get_exponent_dynamic() in libavcodec/nellymoserenc.c) is not compiled. The restricted build starts with --disable-everything and its explicit encoder list (libopenh264, aac, mjpeg, wrapped_avframe and pcm_s16le) does not include it, and libavcodec/Makefile builds nellymoserenc.o only with CONFIG_NELLYMOSER_ENCODER.

CVE-2026-125258.review: The affected Dolby Vision RPU writer (dovi_configure_ext() in libavcodec/dovi_rpuenc.c) is not compiled: libavcodec/Makefile builds dovi_rpuenc.o only with CONFIG_DOVI_RPUENC, and configure selects it only for the dovi_rpu bitstream filter and the libx265, libaom and libsvtav1 encoders, none of which is enabled. The HEVC decoder selects only the separate dovi_rpudec parser.

CVE-2026-125259.review: The affected ProRes encoder (ff_prores_kostya_encode_init() in libavcodec/proresenc_kostya.c) is not compiled. The restricted build starts with --disable-everything and its explicit encoder list (libopenh264, aac, mjpeg, wrapped_avframe and pcm_s16le) does not include it, and libavcodec/Makefile builds proresenc_kostya.o only with CONFIG_PRORES_KS_ENCODER or CONFIG_PRORES_KS_VULKAN_ENCODER.

CVE-2026-125260.review: The affected OpenEXR encoder (encode_scanline_rle() in libavcodec/exrenc.c) is not compiled. The restricted build starts with --disable-everything and its explicit encoder list (libopenh264, aac, mjpeg, wrapped_avframe and pcm_s16le) does not include it, and libavcodec/Makefile builds exrenc.o only with CONFIG_EXR_ENCODER.

CVE-2026-125261.review: The affected SGI encoder (encode_frame() in libavcodec/sgienc.c) is not compiled. The restricted build starts with --disable-everything and its explicit encoder list (libopenh264, aac, mjpeg, wrapped_avframe and pcm_s16le) does not include it, and libavcodec/Makefile builds sgienc.o only with CONFIG_SGI_ENCODER. The image2 muxer can therefore write only the enabled mjpeg output.

CVE-2026-125262.review: The affected LCEVC enhancement layer (libavcodec/lcevcdec.c) is not compiled: libavcodec/Makefile builds lcevcdec.o only with CONFIG_LIBLCEVC_DEC, which needs the external lcevc_dec library. liblcevc_dec is an autodetected external library in configure, and build-ffmpeg.sh sets --disable-autodetect without --enable-liblcevc-dec. H.264 and HEVC streams carrying LCEVC data are therefore decoded as base layer only.

CVE-2026-125263.review: The advisory requires a build with liblcevc_dec. The affected LCEVC output sizing in libavcodec/decode.c is guarded by CONFIG_LIBLCEVC_DEC, and that library is an autodetected external library in configure; build-ffmpeg.sh sets --disable-autodetect without --enable-liblcevc-dec, so the code is compiled out and frames keep their base-layer dimensions.

CVE-2026-125264.review: The affected JPEG XL parser (parse_frame_header() in libavcodec/jpegxl_parser.c) is not compiled. The restricted build starts with --disable-everything and its explicit parser list (h264, hevc, aac, mpegaudio, opus and vorbis) does not include it, and libavcodec/Makefile builds jpegxl_parser.o only with CONFIG_JPEGXL_PARSER. No JPEG XL decoder or demuxer is enabled either.

CVE-2026-125269.review: The restricted build enables the H.264 metadata filter and compiles libavcodec/cbs_sei.c. clear-sei-message-slot.patch backports upstream FFmpeg commit 2c515eea07df719379e7f73deeeb7ccb8768433f to the pinned source. It clears each SEI message slot as it is handed out, including reused slots, so all restricted builds contain the upstream memory-safety fix. Debian sid continues to report this advisory open.

openh264.review: Pinned upstream 2.7.0 encoder; Debian records no unresolved sid finding. Earlier decoding issues, including CVE-2025-27091, are fixed by this version. FFmpeg does not enable the OpenH264 decoder. Native untrusted decoding stays in its explicitly enabled FFmpeg decoders. Cisco binary-license/patent coverage is not claimed for source builds.

zimg.review: Pinned upstream source, static color-conversion filters. Debian currently records no zimg advisories; absence from that feed is not vulnerability-free certification. No new input format/network parser or remote content flow.

CVE-2026-6385.review: The current primary Debian JSON marks sid resolved, so this finding is no longer in the unresolved-feed set checked by check-advisories.py. The updated description concerns DVD subtitle fragment reassembly reached by MPEG-PS/VOB input. The pinned restricted build still starts with --disable-everything and enables only the MOV demuxer and explicit H.264/HEVC/audio parsers and decoders, excluding MPEG-PS/VOB and DVD subtitle parsing/decoding; runtime input is forced MOV. This does not claim the pinned upstream commit contains a fix or that arbitrary system FFmpeg is safe. An unresolved reappearance remains a new guard failure. Existing restricted binary/runtime gates remain mandatory.
